description: Reviewed decisions for tools/validate-math-notation.mjs. Each entry is a student-facing string whose notation SURVIVES the render-time formatter (engine/core/math-typography.js) but which a human read and judged correct as written. Entry shape: { file, path, rule, reason } where file is the lesson config path, path is the field path the gate prints, rule is the detector id, and reason is 40+ characters saying why the text is right as written. An entry whose finding no longer fires FAILS and must be deleted: stale absolutions are worse than no file. Empty on purpose: on 2026-10-27 every one of the 66,514 scanned strings was clean after the formatter, so nothing was excused rather than lowering a rule.
